definitions.explanation: The act or process of stopping blood flow from a wound. Used in both first aid and medical contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{止血|しけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{傷口|きずぐち}→傷口：09517_kizuguchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{押|お}さえて→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧{止血|しけつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I pressed hard on the wound to stop the bleeding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{救急|きゅうきゅう}→救急：15075_kyuukyuu⟧{講習|こうしゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{止血|しけつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I learned how to stop bleeding in a first aid course.

notes:
Composed of {止|し} (to stop) and {血|けつ} (blood). An essential first aid term. Also functions as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {止血|しけつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to stop the bleeding).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {止血|しけつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to stop the bleeding
- {止血|しけつ}⟦{帯|たい}→〜帯：30366_tai⟧ — tourniquet
- {止血|しけつ}⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ — hemostatic agent, styptic
- {止血|しけつ}⟦{処置|しょち}→処置：05823_shochi⟧ — hemostatic treatment

USAGE:
Appears in first aid instructions, medical discussions, and emergency situations. In first aid, the basic method is ⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{圧迫|あっぱく}→圧迫：12013_appaku⟧{止血|しけつ}⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (direct pressure hemostasis) — pressing firmly on the wound.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{出血|しゅっけつ}→出血：11735_shukketsu⟧ — bleeding, hemorrhage
- ⟦{流血|りゅうけつ}→流血：19781_ryuuketsu⟧ — bloodshed; more dramatic and figurative
- ⟦{輸血|ゆけつ}→輸血：04083_yuketsu⟧ — blood transfusion
